Every two years our Rising Stars of Private Debt list highlights the people the industry thinks will be its future leaders.

PEI Private Credit ’s Rising Stars of Private Credit 2026 list recognises the up-and-coming professionals driving innovation across the asset class. The PEI Private Credit senior editorial team pored over hundreds of nominations to find the LPs, GPs, lawyers and advisers under 40 making their mark in an increasingly complex private credit market.

Visit our special reports section , where you’ll find an extensive library of PEI Private Credit reports on the key issues affecting the industry.
